comment:
* A popup window used by the floating toolbar to render menu items in the local app process.
 *
 * This class is responsible for the rendering/animation of the floating toolbar.
 * It holds 2 panels (i.e. main panel and overflow panel) and an overflow button
 * to transition between panels.

variables.name: MIN_OVERFLOW_SIZE
variables.comment: Minimum and maximum number of items allowed in the overflow.

variables.name: mParent
variables.comment: Parent for the popup window.

variables.name: mMarginHorizontal
variables.comment: Margins between the popup window and its content.

variables.name: mContentContainer
variables.comment: holds all contents.

variables.name: mMainPanel
variables.comment: holds menu items that are initially displayed.

variables.name: mOverflowPanel
variables.comment: holds menu items hidden in the overflow.

variables.name: mOverflowButton
variables.comment: opens/closes the overflow.

variables.name: mArrow
variables.comment: overflow button drawables.

variables.name: mLogAccelerateInterpolator
variables.comment: Animation interpolators.

variables.name: mShowAnimation
variables.comment: Animations.

variables.name: mViewPortOnScreen
variables.comment: portion of screen we can draw in.

variables.name: mCoordsOnWindow
variables.comment: popup window coordinates.

variables.name: mTmpCoords
variables.comment: Temporary data holders. Reset values before using.

variables.name: mPreparePopupContentRTLHelper
variables.comment: * @see OverflowPanelViewHelper#preparePopupContent().

variables.name: mDismissed
variables.comment: tracks whether this popup is dismissed or dismissing.

variables.name: mHidden
variables.comment: tracks whether this popup is hidden or hiding.

variables.name: mOverflowButtonSize
variables.comment: Calculated sizes for panels and overflow button.

variables.name: mOverflowPanelSize
variables.comment: Should be null when there is no overflow.

variables.name: mMenuItems
variables.comment: Menu items and click listeners

variables.name: mOpenOverflowUpwards
variables.comment: Whether the overflow opens upwards or downwards.

variables.name: mTransitionDurationScale
variables.comment: Used to scale the toolbar transition duration.

methods.comment: * Performs the "show" animation on the floating popup.

methods.comment:
* Defines the position of the floating toolbar popup panels when transition animation has
     * stopped.

methods.name: private void setZeroTouchableSurface()
methods.comment:
* Sets the touchable region of this popup to be zero. This means that all touch events on
     * this popup will go through to the surface behind it.

methods.name: private void setContentAreaAsTouchableSurface()
methods.comment: * Sets the touchable region of this popup to be the area occupied by its content.

methods.name: private void setTouchableSurfaceInsetsComputer()
methods.comment:
* Make the touchable area of this popup be the area specified by mTouchableRegion.
     * This should be called after the popup window has been dismissed (dismiss/hide)
     * and is probably being re-shown with a new content root view.
